data.title: Pregnant teacher ends her life after boyfriend denies paternity
data.description: A pregnant teacher has commited suicide in her car, leaving a letter citing heartbreak because her boyfriend refused to acknowledge paternity of their child.

data.title: BDMS to Host Annual Academic Conference 2026 on AI-Era Healthcare Innovation
data.description: Bangkok, August 27, 2026 – Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Public Company Limited (BDMS) is reaffirming its commitment to advancing medical and multidisciplinary excellence while promoting ongoing academic collaboration and knowledge exchange. The company will host the BDMS Academic Annual Meeting 2026 under the theme “Innovative Healthcare Across the Lifespan” from Nov 9-13, 2026, at the BDMS Connect Center, Wireless Road, Bangkok. Held in a hybrid format with onsite participation and online access via Zoom, the conference will broaden access to medical knowledge and provide a platform for healthcare professionals, academics, researchers, and interested participants nationwide to exchange ideas and experiences. Registration is open through October 20, 2026.

data.title: South Korea court gives Unification Church leader 2 years prison
data.description: SEOUL - A South Korean court sentenced the leader of the secretive and powerful Unification Church on Monday to two years in prison on charges of bribing officials, including the then president's wife.
